column2: the chief of Pharaoh's butlers, a lean, well-groomed Egyptian courtier with a shaved head, in fine white linen
the chief of Pharaoh's bakers, a broad-faced Egyptian courtier with a short black wig, in white linen with a coloured sash
Joseph's Egyptian wife, the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On: a woman with a long black braided wig and kohl-lined eyes, in fine pleated white linen and a beaded collar
the ruler of Joseph's house, an Egyptian steward with a shaved head, in a white linen robe with a blue sash
Joseph's elder son, born in Egypt: a grown young man, clean-shaven, with short dark hair, in white Egyptian linen
Joseph's younger son, born in Egypt: a grown young man a little younger than his brother, clean-shaven, with short dark hair, in white Egyptian linen with a blue sash
